policy: Reject every new signature or increased occurrence. All product-owned label and sentence fragments are repaired. The one protected external-source finding remains a separate debt row. Individually reviewed complete-paragraph joins in nonFindings require exact source SHA, signature and occurrence count; they cannot offset debt.

findings.residual: External decompiled Shizuku source is protected by the pinned formatter/source-origin contract; no product-owned caller translates command/user text.
